exact: envenomation resulting in fibrinolysis in another organism
envenomation resulting in fibrinolysis in other organism

definition: A process in which an organism causes fibrinolysis in another organism via the action of a venom. Fibrinolysis is a process that solubilizes fibrin in the blood, chiefly by the proteolytic action of plasmin.
label: venom-mediated fibrinolysis
